video_title: Rockets Think Amen Thompson Has HUGE Potential & Is Untradeable

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson's five-year, $208 million rookie extension with the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Amen Thompson did his five-year $208 million extension with the Houston Rockets.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: We haven't spoken since Amen Thompson did his five-year $208 million extension with the Houston Rockets. It's the first couple days of September, a little bit of an unusual time to get a contract extension done, but the Rockets were pleased with doing this because they've held their ground in rookie extensions.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: I mean, we could say Jalen Green back then. Jaylen Green, that was definitely a creative deal that happened near the deadline.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's decision to accept a 25% rookie extension
quotes.excerpt: In the case of Victor Wembanyama there's no question it's an example of willingly taking less.
quotes.quote: So far, there's only two from this first-round draft class at least. Both of them are examples of willingly taking less. In the case of Victor Wembanyama there's no question it's an example of willingly taking less. He hadn't technically qualified for the supermax escalator, the 30%, but if he plays 65 games it's an absolute no-brainer that he will. He said, 'Nope, I'll do 25% flat. I don't need anymore. I want to have flexibility.'

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA teams prioritizing cap flexibility for future trades
quotes.excerpt: This is not about cap space, it's about room to the aprons.
quotes.quote: The way that teams are thinking about these figures is not about cap space, it's about room to the aprons. Because that's what these playoff teams, these contenders, that's what they're talking about when they talk about flexibility, because that's how trades are made now. If you're talking about seven, eight million dollars in a year, that is some significant wiggle room when you're trying to stay under an apron.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The Rockets' high valuation of Amen Thompson
quotes.excerpt: If there's one untradeable player on the roster, it is him.
quotes.quote: For the Rockets, I think it's great business. I've been telling you for a while just how much the Rockets value Amen Thompson. If there's one untradeable player on the roster, it is him. According to their metrics, they think he's one of the top 10 most valuable players in the league. Now, we can argue and we can debate, and you can say that's ridiculous. I'm just telling you the way that they view him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson's offensive struggles and ball-handling potential
quotes.excerpt: There's no doubt that his offense is an issue.
quotes.quote: Anybody who talks about this will immediately talk about his offensive struggles. That's been what we've talked about since he was coming out of overtime and post-high school. There's no doubt that his offense is an issue. His shooting, to be clear, which got worse actually from long range last year. His ball-handling is, he's got some wiggle.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson's role as a dynamic finisher and playmaker
quotes.excerpt: He's a dynamic finisher, obviously. He's a good playmaker, not great, but a good playmaker.
quotes.quote: He's a dynamic finisher, obviously. He's a good playmaker, not great, but a good playmaker. He's good attacking off the dribble. He's just a complete non-shooter at this point.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Rockets' long-term outlook for Amen Thompson
quotes.excerpt: It's a five-year contract. He's got this year left on his deal, so it's really a six-year deal.
quotes.quote: I had one executive say to me, 'It's a five-year contract. He's got this year left on his deal, so it's really a six-year deal. How many All-Star teams is he making in those six years?'

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Amen Thompson to Franz Wagner
quotes.excerpt: Talk to me about Franz Wagner. If you're building a team, would you rather have Paolo Banchero or Amen Thompson?
quotes.quote: Talk to me about Franz Wagner. If you're building a team, would you rather have Paolo Banchero or Amen Thompson?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The high demand for versatile defensive players like Amen Thompson
quotes.excerpt: I think a lot of people would take Amen because what he does is so highly desired.
quotes.quote: I think a lot of people would take Amen because what he does is so highly desired in the league, and you need versatile athletic defense. It's harder to find than what Paolo does, which is, you know, offense first. The magic have continued to be outscored with Paolo on the court. It's been happening for years.
